title: Seahawks’ big trade is exactly what they need - The Seattle Times
description: The Seahawks are in a better position to repeat as Super Bowl champs because they traded for guard Quenton Nelson rather than trying to upgrade at running back.

title: Timberwolves' Anthony Edwards (knee) to miss up to 2 months, sources say - ESPN
description: Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards will undergo an arthroscopic procedure on his ailing right knee that will sideline him up to two months, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

title: Savannah Chrisley stands by ‘huge’ age gap with fiancé after announcing pregnancy - Fox News
description: Savannah Chrisley revealed on her "Unlocked" podcast why she kept her age-gap relationship quiet and how fiancé Jason proposed in December 2025.
